methodology.promotion_rule: This can suggest better reporting bands, but cannot by itself promote a runtime threshold or prove a causal difficulty curve.
methodology.purpose: Check whether the current fixed Zipf bands are a defensible slicing choice for observed veto difficulty and full generated source-family coverage.
methodology.scored_signal: Outcome separation over latest case rows, penalized when a boundary scheme creates underfilled observed bands or lopsided full source-family coverage.
